original_tasks.title: Core model, errors, and add
original_tasks.description: Create todo.py with exceptions, TodoItem dataclass, TodoList with internal storage, an item lookup helper that raises ItemNotFoundError/ValidationError for bad ids, and add(). Tests in tests/test_add.py.
acceptance_criteria: add returns TodoItem with id 1, stripped text, complete False, due_date None, priority 'medium'
empty, whitespace-only and non-str text raise ValidationError
exception class hierarchy is as described

original_tasks.title: List items
original_tasks.description: Implement list() returning a copy ordered by id. Tests in tests/test_list.py.
acceptance_criteria: mutating the returned list does not change the TodoList

original_tasks.title: Complete item
original_tasks.description: Implement complete(item_id) using the id lookup helper. Tests in tests/test_complete.py.
acceptance_criteria: item becomes complete and is returned
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError with id in message

original_tasks.title: Delete item
acceptance_criteria: item removed from list() and returned
ids not reused after delete then add

original_tasks.title: Rename item
original_tasks.description: Implement rename(item_id, new_text). Tests in tests/test_rename.py.
acceptance_criteria: empty/whitespace/non-str raises ValidationError and text unchanged

original_tasks.title: Set due date
original_tasks.description: Implement set_due_date(item_id, due). Tests in tests/test_due_date.py.

original_tasks.title: Set priority
original_tasks.description: Implement set_priority(item_id, priority). Tests in tests/test_priority.py.
acceptance_criteria: 'urgent', 'HIGH', None raise ValidationError and priority unchanged

original_tasks.title: Search by text
acceptance_criteria: empty, whitespace-only or non-str query raises ValidationError

original_tasks.title: Export to JSON
acceptance_criteria: output parses with json.loads to list of dicts with keys id, text, complete, due_date, priority
due_date is ISO string or null

original_tasks.title: Import from JSON with validation
original_tasks.description: Implement import_json(json_str), validating everything before replacing state (atomic). Tests in tests/test_import.py.
acceptance_criteria: valid import returns count and preserves ids and fields
next add id is greater than max imported id
export->import round trip into fresh TodoList gives equal items
invalid JSON, non-list, non-object items, missing/wrong-typed fields, bad priority, bad due_date, empty text, duplicate ids each raise ValidationError
existing items unchanged after a failed import
